title: add top level LICENSE file
body:
Ever since the move to the monorepo we had no top level LICENSE file where most people would look and scan for.

While each go module has the LICENSE file in the its top level dir which is good since the module is distributed like that without our real top level dir it does mean there is a possible gap for unknown licensed code outside the go modules, i.e. the CI scripts under hack/.

The file is a one to one copy from image/LICENSE.

<!--- Please read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/containers/container-libs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before proceeding --->

comments.body:
I am not sure it is technically required but I guess it is best to declare a proper license for all content including the CI scripts and so on.

Looking at the history, its just 4 authors for the Makefile and hack/ so I guess it would be best if we could all ack that officially.
